Taylor Swift's "Fifteen" reached #23 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Fifteen" is a song written and recorded by the American singer-songwriter Taylor Swift for her second studio album, Fearless (2008).

The song peaked at #23 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 21 weeks on the chart.

Fifteen was released in 2008.
